Yes, damaged items are handled differently from normal returns:
Damaged or Defective Items:
Returns due to verified manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement, including shipping fees, under our warranty
No restocking fees apply when the damage is caused by Avocado's manufacturing or logistics teams
You'll receive a prepaid return shipping label at no cost

Normal Returns (non-damaged):
Furniture returns have a 20% restocking fee (waived only for exchanges of equal or greater value)
Shipping fees and optional in-home setup services are non-refundable
Items must be in like-new condition with no signs of use, damage, or wear
